title: Classify dynamic DAG inputs independently from pass mode
proposed_rule: In post-synthesis DAG descriptors, types 0 and 4 are producer dependencies, 1 and 5 are static external inputs, and 2 and 6 are dynamic DAG inputs. The 4-bit selects pointer pass mode; bit 0 alone does not determine ownership.
prompt: When a dynamic dag_input is misreported as a parent-task dependency, inspect the full numeric descriptor type. Treat {1,2,5,6} as external and {0,4} as producer dependencies; reject unknown types explicitly.
scope: ACE-ECHO Gem5 DAG hydration and dependency parsing

evidence.failure: task 0 input pbch_llr has invalid parent task 0
evidence.tests: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_gem5_descriptor_types.py: 4/4 PASS

rollback: Revert the isolated ACE-ECHO adapter commit; no DSL, Gem5 execution semantics, workload, or RTL source is changed.
